lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: measurement and technology applications

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A student simplifies 2^3 × 2^4 as 2^12. Which statement best analyzes the error?

steps: Multiplying like bases adds the exponents, it does not multiply them.
workedSolution.answer: The exponents should be added, not multiplied: 3 + 4 = 7, so the product is 2^7.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A student multiplies (6 × 10^2) × (5 × 10^-1) and writes 30 × 10^1. Which statement best analyzes the claim?
choices: The coefficients should have been added, not multiplied: 11 × 10^1.
The value is correct but not in scientific notation; 30 × 10^1 should be rewritten as 3 × 10^2.
The claim is correct and already in scientific notation.
The exponents should have been multiplied: 30 × 10^-2.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
